purpose: Teach: 土器/怪奇/輸血/波形/上演/決心/変数/駒

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、土器、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, you really did tackle pottery history in your paper with such seriousness. I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm, measured recognition. Gentle opening with his name. Pause before the praise—not gushing, but genuine. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone who reads carefully and notices depth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。文学の、本気で、絶対、怪奇、絶対、現象、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really did put serious effort into researching the strange phenomena in literature for that paper.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity, slightly awkward gratitude. Small intake of breath before speaking, like he's checking himself. Earnest but not performative. A touch of relief that the work was seen.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 医療の、本気で、絶対、輸血、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: Your perspective on medical history—transfusions especially—in your paper was remarkably broad. That kind of scholarship really does impress me.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the opening. Genuine discovery in her voice, like she's still processing his scope. Warm but precise. The rhythm of someone who appreciates the work, not just the effort.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。音響の、本気で、絶対、波形、絶対、解析、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I put real thought into analyzing acoustic waveforms for that research. Thank you for recognizing it.
lines.style: Soft affirmation. Small nod in the voice. Gratitude that feels earned, not expected. Steady but brief—he's not the type to elaborate unprompted.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 劇場での、本気で、絶対、上演、絶対、史、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: And the way you handled theatrical performance history in your paper—I was really taken with that.
lines.style: Engaged and present. She leans forward slightly in her tone. A touch of delight in discovering something unexpected. Not condescending praise, but genuine recognition of a student who reaches.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴史上の人物の、本気で、絶対、決心、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I researched the resolve and decisions of historical figures carefully for that paper. I'm grateful you saw that.
lines.style: Humble affirmation. Quiet pride held in check. He's still processing that his work is being truly seen. Small, genuine thank you at the close.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 数学の、本気で、絶対、変数、絶対、概念史、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of the concept of variables across mathematical history in your paper was really something special.
lines.style: Reflective warmth. She's genuinely turning something over in her mind as she speaks. Slower pace, like the words are carefully chosen. Not effusive, but sincere recognition of intellectual reach.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。将棋の、本気で、絶対、駒、絶対、文化史、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I really did dig into the cultural history of shogi pieces for that research. Thank you for that.
lines.style: Grateful closure. Slightly softer than before—the conversation has worn a small groove of trust. Earnest, not rushed. Quiet relief at having been truly listened to.
